proposals.evidence: DEDR 4345 records Tamil pū, Malayalam pū/pūvu, Kannada pūvu, Gadaba pū/puvvu, Parji pū, Gondi puŋgar and Kurux pūmp flower. The selected simple flower forms fit these comparanda; Indo-Aryan-looking phul and uncertain responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
